knowledge:
- key_parameters: countData=A data frame or data.table containing sliding window counts for IP and SMI samples ;; annotObj=A data frame containing genomic coordinates and annotations for each sliding window ;; design=Formula specifying the experimental design, typically ~type where type is IP vs SMI ;; maxCountFile=Path to a file containing maximum crosslink counts per window for prefiltering ;; countThresh=Minimum count threshold used in filterCounts ;; nsamples=Minimum number of samples that must meet the countThresh in filterCounts ;; fitType=Dispersion fit method in estimateDispersions, typically 'parametric' or 'local' ;; contrast=Character vector specifying the comparison, e.g., c('type', 'IP', 'SMI') ;; padjCol=The column name in window results containing adjusted p-values for extractRegions ;; padjThresh=Significance threshold for adjusted p-values in extractRegions ;; log2FoldChangeThresh=Log2 fold change threshold for extractRegions
- alternatives: csaw=A Bioconductor package for sliding window analysis of ChIP-seq data. csaw uses the SIMES method to combine windows, which is suitable for large cDNA fragments but punishes p-values for long stretches of overlapping windows. DEWSeq is preferred for single-nucleotide resolution iCLIP/eCLIP data because it corrects the p-value for each overlapping window with the number of overlaps using Bonferroni correction.
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing eCLIP, iCLIP, or similar CLIP-seq protocols that provide single-nucleotide resolution crosslink/truncation count data, specifically when biological replicates and size-matched input (SMI) controls are available.
- pitfalls: Using total RNA-seq, IgG, or empty beads as input controls instead of size-matched input (SMI) controls, which can lead to false positives due to unspecific background ;; Failing to perform a second trimming step for standard paired-end eCLIP libraries (due to a protocol bug) ;; Not accounting for data asymmetry (enrichment in IP over control) during size factor estimation; the docs recommend identifying and excluding temporarily significant windows before final size factor calculation ;; Choosing an inappropriate dispersion fit (parametric vs local); the docs suggest comparing residuals of both fits to choose the best one.

workflows.name: dewseq_clip_analysis
workflows.intent: Identify differentially enriched RNA-binding protein binding regions from eCLIP/iCLIP sliding window count data compared to size-matched input controls.
input: countFile.txt.gz (Tab-separated sliding window count matrix with unique IDs and sample counts)
annotationFile.txt.gz (Tab-separated annotation file containing genomic coordinates and gene metadata for each unique window ID)
maxCountFile.txt.gz (Optional tab-separated file with maximum crosslink counts per window for prefiltering)
workflows.stages: 1. Load count and annotation data using fread ;; 2. Define sample metadata (colData) and construct a DESeqDataSet using DESeqDataSetFromSlidingWindows ;; 3. Prefilter low-count windows using filterCounts ;; 4. Estimate size factors, optionally adjusting for asymmetric enrichment by temporarily identifying and excluding significant windows ;; 5. Estimate dispersions (comparing parametric and local fits) and run the Wald test using estimateDispersions and nbinomWaldTest ;; 6. Perform one-sided significance testing for IP enrichment using resultsDEWSeq ;; 7. Apply multiple hypothesis correction using IHW ;; 8. Combine overlapping significant windows into binding regions using extractRegions ;; 9. Export the final regions to a BED file using toBED
workflows.code:
require(DEWSeq)
require(IHW)
require(tidyverse)
require(data.table)

countData <- fread(countFile, sep = "\t")
annotationData <- fread(annotationFile, sep = "\t")

colData <- data.frame(
  row.names = colnames(countData)[-1], # since the first column is unique_id
  type      = factor(
                c(rep("IP", 2),    ##  change this accordingly
                  rep("SMI", 1)),  ##
                levels = c("IP", "SMI"))
)

ddw <- DESeqDataSetFromSlidingWindows(countData  = countData,
                                      colData    = colData,
                                      annotObj   = annotationData,
                                      tidy       = TRUE,
                                      design     = ~type)

ddw <- estimateSizeFactors(ddw)

ddw <- filterCounts( object = ddw,maxCountFile = maxCountFile, 
                      countThresh = 5,nsamples = 2)

ddw_mRNAs <- ddw[ rowData(ddw)[,"gene_type"] == "protein_coding", ]
ddw_mRNAs <- estimateSizeFactors(ddw_mRNAs)
sizeFactors(ddw) <- sizeFactors(ddw_mRNAs)

ddw_tmp <- ddw
ddw_tmp <- estimateDispersions(ddw_tmp, fitType = "local", quiet = TRUE)
ddw_tmp <- nbinomWaldTest(ddw_tmp)
ddw_tmp_results <- results(ddw_tmp,contrast = c("type", "IP", "SMI"),
                           tidy = TRUE, filterFun =  ihw)
tmp_significant_windows <- ddw_tmp_results %>%
                           dplyr::filter(padj < 0.05) %>% 
                           dplyr::pull(row)
rm(list = c("ddw_tmp", "ddw_tmp_results"))

ddw_mRNAs <- ddw_mRNAs[ !rownames(ddw_mRNAs) %in% tmp_significant_windows, ]
ddw_mRNAs <- estimateSizeFactors(ddw_mRNAs)
sizeFactors(ddw) <- sizeFactors(ddw_mRNAs)
rm( list = c("tmp_significant_windows", "ddw_mRNAs"))

decide_fit <- TRUE
parametric_ddw  <- estimateDispersions(ddw, fitType="parametric")
if(decide_fit){
  local_ddw  <- estimateDispersions(ddw, fitType="local")
}

parametricResid <- na.omit(with(mcols(parametric_ddw),abs(log(dispGeneEst)-log(dispFit))))
if(decide_fit){
  localResid <- na.omit(with(mcols(local_ddw),abs(log(dispGeneEst)-log(dispFit))))
  residDf <- data.frame(residuals=c(parametricResid,localResid),
                        fitType=c(rep("parametric",length(parametricResid)),
                                  rep("local",length(localResid))))
}

if (median(localResid) <= median(parametricResid)){
  cat("chosen fitType: local")
  ddw <- local_ddw
}else{
  cat("chosen fitType: parametric")
  ddw <- parametric_ddw
}
rm(local_ddw,parametric_ddw,residDf,parametricResid,localResid)

ddw <- estimateDispersions(ddw, fitType = "local", quiet = TRUE)
ddw <- nbinomWaldTest(ddw)

resultWindows <- resultsDEWSeq(ddw,
                              contrast = c("type", "IP", "SMI"),
                              tidy = TRUE) %>% as_tibble

resultWindows[,"p_adj_IHW"] <- adj_pvalues(ihw(pSlidingWindows ~ baseMean, 
                     data = resultWindows,
                     alpha = 0.05,
                     nfolds = 10))

resultWindows <- resultWindows %>% 
                      mutate(significant = resultWindows$p_adj_IHW < 0.01)

resultRegions <- extractRegions(windowRes  = resultWindows,
                                padjCol    = "p_adj_IHW",
                                padjThresh = 0.01, 
                                log2FoldChangeThresh = 0.5) %>% as_tibble

toBED(windowRes = resultWindows,
      regionRes = resultRegions,
      fileName  = "enrichedWindowsRegions.bed")
